authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.contract: Legacy owners accept absolute or relative soft-pointer encodings; common persistent reactors require absolute soft-pointer role 4. Relative roles 6, 8, 10, and 12 resolve by +1, -1, +offset, and -offset respectively.

change.targetedControl: The shared common-tail helper consumes each generated in-memory frame, validates exact target resolution and final byte padding, then checks same-target corrected frames after reactor-role rejection.

validation.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_ac1014_dictionaryvar_tests dwg2dxf -j4 && ctest --test-dir build-gcc --output-on-failure -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_ac1014_dictionaryvar$'
validation.result: PASS; -Werror target build completed and focused CTest passed 1/1 in 0.28 seconds. All four relative owner encodings are accepted and those encodings are refused in the reactor position across AC1012/AC1014/AC1015.

addressSanitizer.result: PASS; focused CTest passed 1/1 in 0.38 seconds with -fsanitize=address.

limits: The generated frames are in-memory controls, not producer-authored DWGs.
This closes only the shared helper's owner/reactor role matrix; it does not establish native duplicate-merge behavior, strict AC1012 export, or broader DWG/DXF support.
